## Checklist
- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass; tests cover new behaviour
- [ ] Design docs, `design/decisions.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` (*Unreleased*) updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Fictional data only; no notes, journals, tokens or `.env` in the diff
- [ ] New dependencies are GPLv3-compatible; new source files have the SPDX header
